::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
A shift from scaling *training* to scaling *inference*: models that "think
longer" — generating extended reasoning chains and searching over them at
test time (o1-style) — trade compute-per-query for accuracy on hard problems.
:::
